TIMG.SE.I2.summary: A single street door from the *Decumanus* leads through a vestibule onto a ten-column court whose porticoes distribute to nine cellular rooms, with a three-bayed reception room on the entrance axis holding the house's figured floor. Redrawn on confidence-graded layers in September 2026: sixteen spaces, one entrance, two circulation rings through the porticoes. The court is square, with a well and planters rather than a semicircular *atrium*; the tripartite front of the reception room is confirmed; no street-facing room opens onto the street, so the house reads as one household with no commercial fringe.
